title: 德莱厄斯·铁阶赤风
description: 德莱厄斯穿厚重红黑甲胄站在铁灰石阶，大斧斧首落地、双手平静扶柄，披风受强侧光照亮。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Darius is a broad adult Noxian man with short black hair, a square stern face, heavy dark metal armor, red cloth accents, and a fur-edged collar. Preserve his powerful natural adult build, fully armored torso, covered legs, and sturdy boots. His enormous broad-bladed axe rests with its head flat on the ground, held calmly by the upright handle without any raised strike.
art_direction.scene: He stands squarely on an expansive fortress stair landing, gaze directed beyond the viewer and both hands loosely bracing the grounded axe handle. The red cape forms one clear diagonal behind him. A hard warm sidelight carves steel planes against cool shadow, with coarse wax-crayon hatching, a massive plain wall, and distant layered mountains instead of a battlefield.
art_direction.palette: dark iron, deep red, copper light, blue-gray stone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
